dedupe_keys.name: emfac fleet database california on road vehicle population by census block group

description: The EMFAC Fleet Database from the California Air Resources Board (CARB) gives estimates of the on-road vehicle population in California at census block group level, generated from California Department of Motor Vehicles registration data. Coverage: the State of California, by vehicle class from passenger cars and light-duty trucks through medium-duty vehicles and light-heavy, medium-heavy and heavy-heavy duty trucks (T4 to T7, split by gross vehicle weight rating), school, urban and other buses, motor homes and motorcycles; by powertrain (internal combustion including conventional hybrids, battery electric, fuel cell electric and plug-in hybrid); by electric range band; and by the number of vehicles per registration address. Format and access: a web query tool on the EMFAC site. Licence and cost: free to query; no licence was stated on the page read. Caveats: estimates derived from registrations, not vehicle activity, and registration address does not show where vehicles operate. The fleet mix can be used to set truck and zero-emission vehicle shares in freight, emission and charging demand models for California. It relates to COPERT and the Vehicle Inventory and Use Survey in the catalogue.
